note: USFS (Helena-Lewis and Clark NF, White Sulphur Springs Ranger District) campground in the southern Little Belt Mountains, about 12 mi up Spring Creek Road (#94) from US 12 (38 mi from White Sulphur Springs). A basic open-meadow campground with a few designated sites (approx 7-10) and plenty of room, so a 23-ft rig fits; potable water, $10 fee (per the local Into the Little Belts guide). The Forest Service does not list it on its own campground pages: call the ranger district before relying on it. --Claude
summary: No Forest Service page for this campground (absent from both pages of the FS Little Belt Mountains listing and every slug tried); visitmt.com covers only the Kootenai Whitetail. Google Maps lists 'Whitetail Camp Campground' as a campground (3.9, 8 reviews, phone 406-236-5100; reviews such as 'Loved it great place to stay', 'Great site by a stream'). Kept as a public campground per the AWH 2026-10-22 rule; values left (they rest on the local guide; FCFS also matches the forest-wide FS statement). Note reworded to name its source and ask travellers to call first.
